title: Reactivity descriptors for sulfur redox kinetics in lithium–sulfur batteries: from mechanistic insights to machine learning driven catalyst design
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00324E, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ziqing Yao, Yulu Zou, Shuangke Liu, Yujie Li, Qingpeng Guo, Chunman Zheng, Weiwei Sun
This work elucidates the intrinsic mechanism of catalysts to enhance the kinetics of sulfur reduction reaction from a descriptor perspective and proposes a new paradigm for the development of high activity catalysts incorporating machine learning.
